decisionsTitle: The club's legal name and CIF on the site: one line on the «about» pages and the contact page, a block under the footer's bar
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29:** «on the about pages and contact pages we need to show "<the club's legal name> (Brasov Runners) CIF <the CIF>" in order to meet legal requirements»; then «and also in the footer, more clearly»; then, with a screenshot of another running club's footer, «look at how other run clubs have this». Their footer: a light band, a row of page links, and three columns under it: the club's legal name as a heading with «C.I.F.» and the country under it; three social marks; «Contact» with a phone and an email.

**Decision.** One Server Component, `ClubIdentity` (`src/shared/ui/ClubIdentity.tsx`), in two shapes.

- **`line`**: «<legal name> (<site name>) · CIF <CIF>», one secondary line that wraps at 320 px. It sits at the end of every «about» page and of the contact page. The «about» pages are the club's standing pages (`/pages/[slug]`, where «Despre» is written) and «Echipa». On the contact page it sits under the form, or under the address where there is no form. Without the CIF it reads «<legal name> (<site name>)».
- **`block`**: under the footer's bar on every page, never inside «Despre club». From `sm` it has three columns; on a phone they stack in small text. The first column is the legal name in the site's heading face, with the site's name in brackets, then «C.I.F. <CIF>» and «România» / "Romania". The middle column holds the club's social marks. They come from the bar's own list, now one helper (`clubSocialLinks`), and the column is hidden when none is set. The last column is «Contact»: the address the club chose to show (§442), the public phone when one is set, and «Scrie-ne» to the contact page. Every link has its glyph and is 44 pixels tall. The block is not the bar, so §372's footer-only exception does not reach it.

**Composed, never typed.** The legal name and the CIF are `CLUB_LEGAL_NAME` and `CLUB_REGISTRATION_NUMBER`, read through `clubFactsFromEnv`: the same variables the legal texts are filled with (§132). The name in brackets is `CLUB_NAME` (§215, §369). The repository is public, so it holds none of the values. Unset (CI, a fresh checkout, the e2e run), the line is absent and so is the block's first column. The other columns keep their places. Two checks now enforce §132's «environment, never source». `yarn secrets:check` reads the three variables from the machine's environment and `.env.local` (`scripts/club-facts-values.mjs`) and refuses a commit whose tracked files carry a value, naming the variable and never the value. `tests/unit/legal-documents/club-facts-no-literal.test.ts` runs the same search over `src/`, `tests/`, `messages/`, `.release/`, `docs/`, `scripts/` and the root's documents. It also checks that the identity's sources and words carry no telephone-shaped number.

**«Telefon public».** No phone setting existed, so there is one optional setting under «Pagini» → «Contact», with its glyph and its «Salvează» behind the §384 confirmation. It is the Administrator's (`canManageClubSettings`, asserted in the action and in the service), like the other contact settings. It is a `platform_settings` row (a key-value store), so there is no migration. It is audited as whether a number is set, never the number, and the save expires the public pages. It keeps the number as typed and dials its digits. An empty box shows none.

**Refused.**

- *The block inside the sticky `<footer>`.* The bar is sticky and one row at every scroll position (§372, §385). Inside it, the block would ride along over every screen. The block follows the `<footer>` as its sibling instead. The bar's box, height and fold are what they were, and the block is what every page ends on. `footer.spec.ts` measures the bar without the block: from the bar's top to the block's top is the one row, and nothing follows the block.
- *The seat.* On many a club's certificate it is a person's address, and the owner asked for the name and the CIF. It can be added as its own line of the first column.
- *`CONTACT_FORM_TO`.* That is who receives the form's messages, not an address the club publishes. The block shows the chosen shown address (§442).
- *A serif heading like the example's.* The block uses the site's heading face.
- *Sample legal facts on the e2e server.* They would change every participant email's sender line (§323) across the suite. The render test sets made-up values («Asociația Exemplu», «RO00000000», a fake phone). The e2e specs check the line and the first column when drawn, and their absence when not, and never compare with a value.
- *A phone variable in the environment.* The club changes a phone without a deploy, like the shown address.
changelogLine: - **The club's legal name and CIF on the site** — «<legal name> (Brașov Runners) · CIF <CIF>» at the end of the club's pages, «Echipa» and the contact page, and a block under the footer on every page: the legal name with «C.I.F.» and «România», the social marks, and «Contact» with the address, an optional «Telefon public» (new under «Pagini» → «Contact») and «Scrie-ne»; the values come from the environment only, and `yarn secrets:check` now refuses a commit that carries one. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Under the footer's bar, on every page, the club's identity block follows the `<footer>` element and is never inside «Despre club», and the bar keeps its one row and its height. From `sm` the block has three columns: the club's legal name with the site's name in brackets, «C.I.F. <CIF>» and «România» / "Romania"; the club's social marks, the bar's own list; and «Contact» with the address shown (§442), the public phone while one is set, and «Scrie-ne» to the contact page. On a phone the columns stack. Every link in the block is at least 44 pixels tall and each mark 44 wide. A column with nothing to show is not drawn; with the legal name unset, nothing of the legal facts shows. Tested in tests/integration/contact/club-identity-render.test.ts, tests/unit/shared/site-footer.test.ts and tests/e2e/footer.spec.ts (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A published standing page and «Echipa» end with one secondary line «<legal name> (<site name>) · CIF <CIF>», composed from CLUB_LEGAL_NAME, CLUB_REGISTRATION_NUMBER and the site's name constant, wrapping inside 320 px. Without the CIF it reads «<legal name> (<site name>)», and without the legal name it is absent. The registered seat is never shown. Tested in tests/integration/contact/club-identity-render.test.ts and tests/e2e/pages.spec.ts (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The contact page shows the same identity line under the form, or under the address where there is no form, and nothing while the legal name is unset. It never shows who receives the messages (CONTACT_FORM_TO). Tested in tests/integration/contact/club-identity-render.test.ts and tests/e2e/contact.spec.ts (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Pagini» → «Contact» has an optional «Telefon public». An Administrator saves a number (digits, spaces, a leading +, brackets, dots and dashes, 6 to 15 digits) or clears it with an empty box, after a confirmation. The server refuses anybody else and anything that is not a number. The save writes an audit row that says whether a number is set, never the number, and expires the public pages. The footer's block shows the number as a tel: link only while one is set. Tested in tests/unit/contact/public-phone.test.ts, tests/integration/contact/public-phone.test.ts and tests/e2e/config-panels.spec.ts (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

No tracked file carries the value of CLUB_LEGAL_NAME, CLUB_REGISTRATION_NUMBER or CLUB_REGISTERED_ADDRESS as the machine's environment or .env.local holds it. `yarn secrets:check` refuses such a commit, naming the variable and never the value, and tests/unit/legal-documents/club-facts-no-literal.test.ts fails on it. The identity's sources and catalogue words carry no telephone-shaped number (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the club's legal name and CIF on the about and contact pages and in a block under the footer, with an optional public phone
